[ASSISTANT_SAID] Steps to take when building work is overrunning include communicating with the builder, checking the contract, seeking legal advice, considering mediation, documenting everything, and keeping a cool head.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Homeowners should communicate with their builder to express concerns about the overrun, ask for explanations, and document all communications in writing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Homeowners should review their building contract to understand remedies available in the event of a delay, including liquidated damages.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Seeking legal advice from a construction lawyer is recommended if homeowners are unsure of their rights under the building contract.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mediation is suggested if disputes cannot be resolved through communication or legal means.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Homeowners should document all communications, delays, and additional costs incurred due to the overrun.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] It is crucial for homeowners to remain calm and professional throughout the process of dealing with building overruns.
